eyebrow: Quick Find exists inside pages too
caption: Object Manager has its own Quick Find box — here, filtering the Fields & Relationships list on an object down to one matching field.

eyebrow: Search boxes behave the same way everywhere
caption: The App Launcher's own search box works identically: type a letter, and every matching app and item narrows live, with matches highlighted.
Two different boxes, two different jobs: the sidebar's Quick Find (green, left) filters categories; Search Setup (top, orange) searches every Setup page by name, org-wide.

steps.label: Know the page name?
steps.sub: use Search Setup — it searches everything, from anywhere in Setup

steps.label: Browsing a category?
steps.sub: use the sidebar's Quick Find to narrow what's already in view

steps.label: Inside Object Manager?
steps.sub: use its own Quick Find to filter that one object's fields or layouts

subtitle: Setup isn't just for admins — it's where your own profile lives too.
